query: How can travel-time surfaces and service-access metrics be validated against household-reported access and movement diaries to verify spatial model outputs?

response.query: How can travel-time surfaces and service-access metrics be validated against household-reported access and movement diaries to verify spatial model outputs?
response.answer: Validate travel-time surfaces and service-access metrics by comparing them to household-reported access and movement diaries, ensuring alignment with actual reported experiences. Use statistical methods to assess accuracy and discrepancies. Cross-check with geographic information systems (GIS) data for spatial validation.
